name: Pre-commit autofix trigger

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [master]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  checks: read
  statuses: read
  contents: read

jobs:
  trigger-autofix:
    if: >
      github.event.pull_request.user.type == 'Bot' ||
      endsWith(github.actor, '[bot]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: shaypal5/pre-commit-ci-autofix-trigger@55d00aab
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
